name: Used / secondary market: NVIDIA H100 80GB SXM5 (bare module, ASKING band)
price_basis: USED-market ASKING prices, bare H100 80GB SXM5 module only, USD, observed 2026-10-03. NOT a sold price. Excludes tax/shipping.
notes: OBSERVATION DATE 2026-10-03. Source sup-price-picclick-ebay-asking. BAND: 5 qualifying bare-SXM listings at $24,118 / $26,880 / $26,888 / $28,500 / $28,888; median $26,880, observed range $24,118-$28,888. n=5 is thin. EXCLUDED from the band, with reasons: an $14,999 'HGX H100 baseboard (GPUs NOT included)' listing is a bare backplane, not a card; an $14,000 'before bid ask me' listing is an unpriced placeholder, not a price; heatsink-only, SXM-to-PCIe adapter, FOR-PARTS and Failed-Code-10 units were dropped by title filter. RELATION TO THE PCIe BAND: the SXM module asks BELOW the PCIe card (~$26,880 vs ~$43,000 median). That is not a market efficiency finding - SXM modules are useless off a baseboard, so the two are not substitutes and the gap is an artifact of comparability, not of value. Any cross-form comparison must state which form factor is priced.
